camera.motion: static (tripod, long telephoto). Horizon row = 437 px in all 529 frames (no tilt/shake). No fixed background landmark exists for a horizontal-pan check; sea texture drifts ~-0.2 px/frame (wave motion, not camera) and the sun drifts +0.10 px/frame right, -0.05 px/frame up (consistent with sun's own motion). Treat object pixel motion as motion relative to the scene.
